evals.prompt: The build for issue #42 is complete. Raise a PR linked to it.
evals.expected_output: A pull request with Resolves #42 in the body, title derived from the issue, opened against the default branch
expectations: The PR body contains Resolves #42 at the top
The PR title is derived from the issue title
The PR is opened against the repo's default branch
The skill does not merge the PR
The skill does not close the issue
The PR URL is reported back to the user

expectations: The skill checks for gh on PATH before proceeding
The skill reports the missing prerequisite clearly
